Key Features:

Project: Intelligent Traffic Violation Detection Platform Description: A comprehensive traffic monitoring solution that combines computer vision and OCR technologies to detect vehicles, capture license plates, measure speeds, and automate violation alerts. The system provides intelligent traffic management with detailed logging and violation tracking.

**Challenge:** Traditional traffic monitoring requires manual observation and is prone to human error. Law enforcement agencies needed an automated system for accurate speed detection, license plate recognition, and violation documentation.

**Solution:** Developed an AI-powered traffic monitoring platform that automatically detects vehicles, measures speeds, captures license plates, and generates violation alerts(if the vehicle exceeds speed limit) with comprehensive logging.

**Technical Architecture:** - **Object Detection:** YOLO for real-time vehicle detection and classification - **Computer Vision:** OpenCV for video processing and speed calculation - **Deep Learning:** PyTorch for custom model training and optimization - **OCR Technology:** Advanced optical character recognition for license plate reading - **Data Processing:** NumPy and Pandas for efficient data manipulation - **Tracking Algorithm:** Custom vehicle tracking for consistent identification - **Alert System:** Real-time notification system for speed violations

**Innovative Features:** - Real-time vehicle detection and classification (cars, trucks, motorcycles) - Accurate speed measurement using advanced tracking algorithms - License plate detection and OCR with high accuracy rates - Intelligent vehicle tracking across multiple camera frames - Automated violation alert system with configurable speed thresholds - Comprehensive logging system with vehicle IDs, timestamps, and speeds - Structured data export for law enforcement integration - Multi-lane traffic monitoring capabilities - Weather and lighting condition adaptability

**System Capabilities:** - Process multiple vehicle streams simultaneously - Generate detailed violation reports with evidence (images, videos) and send the email to the admin/security head - Integration capability with existing traffic management systems - Real-time dashboard for traffic monitoring personnel - Historical data analysis for traffic pattern insights - Configurable violation parameters per location/zone
**Impact:** Deployment:

Project: Face Recognition Attendance System
Description: A sophisticated real-time face recognition attendance and authentication system using  multi-face detection capabilities and dynamic tracking. The system integrates with existing CCTV infrastructure for seamless operation, revolutionising the traditional Attendance taking methods .

**Problem Statement:**
Traditional attendance systems require manual interaction and can be prone to buddy punching. Organizations needed an automated, contactless solution that could integrate with existing security infrastructure.

**Solution:**
Developed an AI-powered attendance system that automatically detects and recognizes faces from CCTV feeds, triggers attendance logging, and integrates with access control systems for door unlocking.

**Technical Implementation:**
- **Computer Vision:** YOLO for real-time face detection with high accuracy
- **Face Recognition:** Dlib for robust face encoding and matching
- **Deep Learning:** Custom neural networks for improved recognition accuracy
- **Video Processing:** OpenCV for real-time video stream processing
- **UI Framework:** PyQt5 for professional desktop application interface
- **Camera Integration:** RTSP protocol for CCTV camera connectivity
- **Database:** MySQL for storing face encodings and attendance records
- **Hardware Integration:** Automatic biometric device triggering

**Advanced Features:**
- Multi-face detection and tracking in real-time video streams
- Dynamic face tracking across multiple camera angles
- Integration with existing CCTV infrastructure via RTSP
-

Automatic biometric punch-in triggering upon recognition
- Door access control integration with automatic unlocking
- Real-time attendance logging with timestamp accuracy
- Comprehensive attendance record management
- Face encoding database with efficient matching algorithms

**Performance Achievements:**
- Real-time processing at 30+ FPS with multiple face detection
- 80%+ face recognition accuracy under various lighting conditions
- Sub-second response time for attendance logging
- Seamless integration with existing security infrastructure
- Zero-touch attendance marking improving hygiene and efficiency
- Reduced attendance fraud and improved accuracy
